note.text: Krug’s Alpha Mark shield grants the proper Shield when Kruglettes die before the shield missile lands.

dispositions.reason: The native Krug driver emits ally shield potential at champion death; it does not simulate shield-missile arrival or Kruglette-death dependencies. Therefore this failure mode is absent from the implementation, but exact live Alpha shielding remains incomplete/uncredited in theoretical compositions. frontline2.rs Krug::died creates Kruglette body pools then directly grants the Alpha ally shield in the same callback; it has no traveling shield missile or separate Kruglette-death callback that can reduce the amount before arrival. The stated erroneous ordering cannot occur along that path, but projectile timing is still approximated. Unit-review owner should retain this specific limitation.

dispositions.reason: One-player offer exclusivity is lobby state; no augment offer pool is searched.

dispositions.reason: Gold proc chance from this selected augment is outside fixed-board combat and item budgets.

note.text: Cooking Pot and Trait Tree are now properly excluded

dispositions.reason: This is an augment-offer exclusion fix. None of these selections is supplied to combat; no generic trait rule is inferred.

note.text: Coven Emblem is no longer offered on carousel after stage 5

dispositions.reason: Exact excluded emblem carousel availability afterstage5; neither carousel offers nor this emblem enter the current item pool.

dispositions.reason: Loot position relative to PvE opponents is outside the combat benchmark and fixed allocation.

dispositions.reason: This exact item is explicitly excluded because it occupies three slots and rolls two random items. Ghost-board item roll copying is not simulated.

note.text: Edge of Night effect no longer persists after breaking apart the item with the Salvager wisp

dispositions.reason: Normal Edge of Night remains modeled and its18.2 thresholds/heal are corrected separately. This bug requires removing/disassembling the item with a selected Salvager Wisp; current combat starts with a fixed allocation and never removes items.

dispositions.reason: Exact excluded Artifact's health retention on allied summoning is a real combat fix. No Hullcrusher item effect enters current pools; do not infer a change to generic health or summon accounting.

note.text: Blossom empowered Essence Theft now properly displays its 1g gold cost

dispositions.reason: The empowered Essence Theft Wisp now displays its1g cost correctly. This is price presentation, not a Blossom HP/stat effect or a new ordinary combat spell.

note.text: Burn VFX from inferno units is now correctly visible

dispositions.reason: Visibility of Inferno burn VFX has no additional stated mechanics change. Apply the separately reviewed burn coefficient changes.

note.text: Fixed instances where units display wrong colored health bars when scouting an opponent

dispositions.reason: Scouting health-bar colors are rendering only.

note.text: Tactician no longer disappears when right-clicking on the player's arena right before the carousel arrival phase

dispositions.reason: Tactician disappearance during carousel arrival concerns the player pawn, not combat champions.
